abstract: Controversy exists in the appropriate management of patients with nonseminomatous testicular cancer presenting as clinical stage B disease. Traditional treatment in the United States has included retroperitoneal lymph-node dissection (RPLND). Conversely, in Europe and other places some of these patients have been managed with primary chemotherapy. The experience with RPLND in clinical stage B disease at Indiana University from 1965 to 1989 was reviewed. A total of 174 patients were considered to be in clinical stage B prior to RPLND. After RPLND, 23% of these patients (n = 41) were found to have pathological stage A disease. In all, 77% (n = 133) were determined to be in pathological stage B. Of those pathological stage B patients who did not receive adjuvant chemotherapy, 65% were cured by RPLND alone. The pathological stage B patients who went on the receive postoperative adjuvant chemotherapy displayed an overall 14% chance of relapse. (Patients treated early in the series did not receive cisplatin-based chemotherapy.) The overall survival over the entire period was 96%. In the more modern era, during which cisplatin-based chemotherapy was available, the overall survival was 98%. RPLND is an effective procedure for the management of clinical stage B nonseminomatous testicular cancer. It provides excellent survival in patients found to have pathological stage B disease; additionally, it avoids the unnecessary toxicity of chemotherapy in the 23% of patients who in fact are in pathological stage A.
abstract_ja: 1965年から1989年にかけてインディアナ大学で後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を受けた、臨床病期Bの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の経験を検討した。郭清前に臨床病期Bとされた患者は174例であった。郭清後、そのうち23%（41例）が病理学的病期Aであった。全体の77%（133例）は病理学的病期Bと判定された。補助化学療法を受けなかった病理学的病期B患者のうち、65%は後腹膜リンパ節郭清のみで治癒した。術後補助化学療法を受けた病理学的病期B患者では、全体で14%に再発がみられた。（初期の症例はシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けていない。）全期間を通じた全生存期間(全生存率)は96%であった。シスプラチン併用化学療法が利用可能になった時期では、全生存期間(全生存率)は98%であった。RPLNDは臨床病期Bの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の管理に有効な手技である。病理学的病期Bの患者で良好な生存が得られ、さらに病理学的病期Aの23%の患者では不要な化学療法による毒性を回避できる。
